content.short: BONAD is a token launchpad on Monad where creators launch tokens and earn trading fees.
content.description: BONAD lets anyone create a token on Monad and take a share of the fees it generates as it trades. Paying creators from trading activity aligns them with sustained volume rather than the launch alone, which is at least a better incentive than the alternative.
content.meta: Create a token on Monad and take a share of the trading fees it generates afterwards.
